nom: Benefit Cosmetics The POREfessional Deep Retreat Pore-Clearing Clay Mask

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report reduced shine and less oiliness, with several calling it the best product they've used for large pores and blackheads on oily skin.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry/sensitive skin reports improvement and no dryness, and another notes the mask is a little drying if used daily so she limits use to once a week.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report clearer T-zones and pores after use, with generally positive results.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin (including one with rosacea and one with eczema) report no irritation or reaction, though one found the container's chemical smell strong.
segments.mature: A reviewer in her seventies and another aged 42 report smaller pores and good results on mature skin, with no negative effects mentioned.

concerns.aging: Older reviewers (42 and nearly 70) report visibly smaller pores and satisfaction with results, with no complaints tied specifically to aging skin.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the mask does not dry out or strip skin even after 30 minutes, but a few note it can be drying if used daily and recommend weekly use instead.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports her facial redness was completely gone after one use; no other redness-specific reports are mentioned.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer references skin barrier health positively, recommending warm water rinse and a full routine afterward, describing skin as smoother rather than compromised.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report the mask helps reduce blackheads and clogged pores, especially on the nose, though one reviewer notes it does not remove every blackhead.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report fewer breakouts and clearer skin with regular use, but one reviewer with acne explicitly states it does not help her acne, and another describes past experience with cystic pimples from other extraction methods (not this product).
concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers with oily skin report the mask visibly draws out oil and reduces shine through the day, with one noting other charcoal products made her oilier but this one did not.

aspects.libelle: Visible oil and blackhead extraction while drying

extraits.texte: I would recommend! I have dry/sensitive skin and I use this only once a week and I have seen so much improvement with a month. It has helped me not break out, brighten and smooth my skin. (I also have eczema, it doesn't bother it. I do have mine controlled so I have not had bad eczema on my face)

extraits.titre: Perfect for sensitive, mature, oily skin
extraits.texte: Hi have very oily skin, I'm 42 and have rosacea. After 1 use, my skin is amazing. Stayed oil free ALL DAY.

At first, I was super disappointed to see the package was half full (or half empty for those who see it the other way), but it was the mini size and I read later they fill them by volume in the regular size can. I didn't really care about that anymore after just one application. Holy Smokes! I rinsed it off to see that not only my pores were clearer than they had been for years but noticeably smaller. Also, the redness in my face was COMPLETELY GONE! That has NEVER happened!!! I was absolutely floored. I looked like my teenage self again....minus the acne. Yes, I not only highly recommend it but I will be ordering the regular size ASAP. This will be my weekly routine that I look forward to!
I have acne and large pores. This does not help with my acne, but as far as clearing my pores on nose, cheeks, and chin man it works!!!

I've been having really bad, visible open pores and no matter how much I clean my skin with products they're full daily . I tried charcoal products but they were making my skin more oily afterwards. This product is wonderful, I didn't expect for my pores to disappear but I would say 50% of them are not visible and those big ones are 50%smaller so I'm very happy with results, however I use it 2-3 times a week , it does not make my skin more oily or doesnt dries it out! I don't really see pores when I put a make up on . The only thing I'm not happy with is the fact container is only a half full :(

I can literally see the bottom of the tin immediately after opening. If this was $10, maybe. However, if you are spending nearly $30 for this, I expect there to be enough product for more than 2 facemasks. I wish I could get a refund. Also has a strong chemical smell upon opening.

I really enjoyed this mask, i have quite big black pores on my nose and this clay mask does miracles. I would not recommend to use it every day as it is a little bit drying, but I use it once a week and the difference is huge.
